prompt: Revise landing, empty-state, and error copy for a small repair service. Preserve all facts and safety constraints, remove generic AI phrasing, and give three materially different but usable voice territories.
assertions: Preserves a fact ledger and regulated/error meaning.
Removes cliché and hedge patterns through concrete rhythm and stance choices.
Three runs vary structure, voice, and design territory without synonym-only changes.
Every check has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; unsupported n/a and bare checkmarks are rejected.
Uses one authoritative self-check and keeps the source facts stable while varying report shape and voice.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (deslop-ui) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
